headline: OpenAI swaps data center for compute campus
dek: The new term surfaced on the eve of the US midterms, per The Verge.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: New name, same build
body: OpenAI now calls its largest data centers compute campuses, per TechRadar and The Verge.
The term appeared in the Grid Protectors Program announcement, on the eve of the midterm elections.

points.t: It begins in Effingham County, Georgia.
Answer the strain on local power grids.
Pay for the costs the company creates.

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Critics respond
body: Holly Elmore of PauseAI US says the word was never the problem, per The Verge.
Abre' Conner of the NAACP says the rename does not fix the problem.

items.t: OpenAI did not comment to The Verge.

caption.hook: OpenAI now calls its largest data centers compute campuses, on the eve of the US midterms.
body: Per TechRadar and The Verge, the term appeared in the Grid Protectors Program announcement, which starts in Effingham County, Georgia, and pledges that the company pays for the costs it creates for local power grids.

Critics quoted by The Verge say a new name does not fix the impact of the buildout. Rival Anthropic made broader data center pledges. The Verge says OpenAI did not answer its request for comment on the rename.
